verdict.rationale: Mercury's own marketing says it syncs with QuickBooks, Xero, and NetSuite and uses AI automations to speed up the close, so it has a first-party ERP sync. The evidence does not show that the sync is real-time or bidirectional, or that it removes manual journal entries. Its webhooks and REST API are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: evidence of real-time sync cadence, bidirectional data flow (ERP back to Mercury), automated journal-entry or reconciliation behavior, depth of documentation for each ERP connector, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
